hook.name: AstroNodeFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools that charges ETH fees on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling fees between a per-pool configurable base and max (1%–6.6%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent immediately to a per-pool fee recipient; exact-output swaps are rejected.
